name: CRIMSON SAND
source:
CRIMSON SAND is a noir sci fi story about a security force operative named Marcus Harper who is investigating a smuggling case.
The further he goes, the clearer it becomes that what is happening is connected not only to illegal shipments, but to larger structures such as corporate and political organizations and those people prefer not to speak about out loud
